reason: Not an appeal: youth court sentencing ruling refusing adult sentence, partly because race and culture diminished moral culpability.
Sentence reduced from three to two years for totality error and because Aboriginal status was not considered by sentencing judge.
Crown conceded judge failed to consider s. 718.2(e); court received Gladue report and substituted time served plus probation.
Judge erred in failing to apply s. 718.2(e) and Gladue; sentence reduced to time served, Gladue reports received.
Court found trial judge properly took Aboriginal status into account under s. 718.2(e); sentence appeal dismissed.
